questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India declares that the seat of Supreme Court is in Delhi?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Article 130__**.

__
 
• Article 130 of the Indian Constitution declares that the Supreme Court seat sits in Delhi.
 
• The Supreme Court of India sits in Delhi or Any other Place in India Only if the Chief Justice of India, may with the approval of the President of India.
 
• This provision of the Indian Constitution is only optional and not compulsory. 
 
• The Supreme Court of India includes the Chief Justice and 33 other Judges appointed by the President of India.

• Article 126-Appointment of acting Chief Justice.

questions.question: The natural growth rate of a population is analysed by which of the following factors?
questions.solution:

• It is used to measure the degree to a population which is growing.
 
• The difference of Birth and Deaths is divided by 10 to convert this rate into a percentage.

questions.question: A nominated member of a House shall be disqualified for being a member of the House if he joins any political party after the expiry of __________from the date on which he takes his seat.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Six Months__**.

__
 
• A Nominated member of any house of the Indian Parliament shall be disqualified for being a member of the house if he joins any political party after the expiry of **Six Months.**
 
• This Section comes under **Disqualification on grounds of defection.**
 
• States that a nominated member shall be disqualified if he/she joins any political party after six months from the date he/she takes his seat.
 
• This Anti-Defection law was passed by the Indian Parliament in the year 1985 by the 52nd Amendment of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• ​Article 32.
 
• Article 226.

questions.question: Arrange the following rivers as they occur from the North to South direction in India.
questions.solution:
Correct answer is __**Indus, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Satluj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indus, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Satluj** are rivers,** **occur in the North-South direction in India.
 
• **Jhelum and Ravi join Chenab, Beas joins Sutlej, and then Sutlej and Chenab** combine to form Panjnad 10 miles north of Uch Sharif in **Muzaffar Garh district. **
 
• The combined stream runs southwest for roughly **45 miles** and joins the **Indus River at Mithankot.**
 
• Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas and Sutlej are** branches of the Indus River.**
